card.name: Salt and ion names in drug text
card.fires_on: The first word of a salt or ion name, mainly lithium or sodium, right before its partner word such as carbonate, bicarbonate, valproate or metabisulfite. It also fires inside names like phosphates and phenylbutyrate.
